activity.notes: Sulla seized Rome in 82 BCE and was empowered as dictator with extraordinary authority for constitutional reorganization. Modern scholarship conventionally treats the Sullan dictatorship as 82–79 BCE, ending with his resignation. ATLAS models this bounded extraordinary-rule interval under the Roman Republic rather than extending a synthetic rail over his earlier military and consular career.
